title: Amendment No. 3, College and Career Access Pathway (CCAP) Partnership Agreement - District and Peralta Community College District (PCCD)
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 3, College and Career Access Pathway Partnership Agreement (CCAP) by and between the District (OUSD) and the Peralta Community College District (PCCD), amending the Agreement to provide for Course Agreement to include an online/distance learning model in which students and instructors engage through electronic devices; notification among and by the parties of COVID-19 related requirements impacting students and instructors, as specified; if not voided by Chancellor’s Office, the Agreement shall become effective on the effective date and continue in effect through June 30, 2023, unless otherwise terminated by the Parties. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
headline: Updates the Peralta college partnership to allow online classes and add COVID-19 notices, no cost
summary: This is the third amendment to the College and Career Access Pathway (CCAP) agreement between the district and Peralta Community College District. It allows college courses to be taught online or by distance learning and requires the parties to notify each other of COVID-19 requirements. The agreement now runs through June 30, 2023, and all other terms stay the same.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
